title: Choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time

abstractEnglish: We prove that choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time on unordered finite structures, confirming the noncapture conjecture of Blass, Gurevich and Shelah. A linear-consistency query over 𝔽3 in a fixed binary vocabulary is decidable in polynomial time but not in the full counting formalism.
